question: Which part of the muscular system attaches bone to bone?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ligament**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ligaments** are fibrous connective tissues that connect bones to other bones.
 
• They provide **stability and support to joints **by limiting excessive movement.
 
• Unlike tendons, which connect muscles to bones, ligaments specifically connect bone to bone.
 
• Ligaments are crucial for **maintaining the structural integrity **of the skeletal system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of Ligaments:**

 
 
• **Capsular Ligaments:** These are part of the articular capsule that surrounds synovial joints.
 
• **Extracapsular Ligaments:** These lie outside the joint capsule and provide additional support.
 
• **Intracapsular Ligaments:** These are found within the joint capsule and provide stability from within.
 
 
 
• **Common Injuries:**
 
 
• **Sprains:** Overstretching or tearing of ligaments, often occurring in the ankle, knee, or wrist.
 
• **Torn Ligaments:** Severe sprains where the ligament is completely torn, often requiring surgical intervention.
